selection.normalisation: counts per 10,000 over all human ENSG features, then log1p, averaged over cells in a group
selection.genes: top 2000 human genes by mean normalised expression in 24 h vehicle cells pooled over the three lines, excluding MT- genes, plus every anchor gene present in the feature table; HGNC symbol required
selection.chunk_rule: cells of each group are assigned to 8 disjoint chunks by a seeded permutation; a chunk mean is a minibulk view

split.unit: skeleton group: first block of the InChIKey of the largest fragment, so salts and stereoisomers of one molecule share a fold
split.stratify: pathway_level_1; within a stratum, groups are ordered by sha256('maestro-biodepth-v1|' + skeleton) and dealt round-robin
split.inner_validation: within each training fold, skeleton groups with sha256('maestro-biodepth-inner|' + skeleton) in the lowest 15 percent are used for early stopping and ridge alpha only
split.held_out_together: all doses and all three lines of a compound

arms.systematic: mean training-fold shift at the same cell line and dose
arms.ridge_chem: ridge on Morgan r2 2048-bit fingerprint crossed with cell-line one-hot, plus cell-line one-hot, times the gate log1p(dose)/log1p(10000); alpha from {1,10,100,1000} by inner validation
arms.knn_chem: Tanimoto-weighted mean of the 5 most similar training compounds' observed shifts at the same line and dose
arms.mlp_existing: virtual_cell.learned_response.fit_response on Morgan r2 512-bit fingerprint, line one-hot and dose gate, target = 64 SVD components of training shifts; the repository's current learned rung
arms.latent_pca: PCA encoder (D=128) fitted on training minibulks + the shared transition head
arms.latent_mae: masked-reconstruction encoder (same architecture, masking and views as JEPA, loss in gene space) + the shared transition head
arms.latent_jepa: JEPA encoder (context encoder on a masked minibulk, EMA target encoder on a different-cell minibulk of the same group, latent predictor) + the shared transition head
arms.latent_jepa_moa: latent_jepa plus a pathway_level_2 embedding in the transition head (annotation-conditioned family)
arms.latent_jepa_moa_shuffled: latent_jepa_moa with pathway_level_2 permuted across skeleton groups (seed 20260926)
arms.replicate_ceiling: replicate 1 shift scored against replicate 2 shift; a noise ceiling, not a model

latent.module_rule: k-means (k=64, seed 0) on standardised training minibulk profiles transposed (genes as points)
latent.decoder: ridge (alpha 1.0) from frozen latent to standardised gene profile, fitted on training minibulks

transition.inputs: Morgan r2 2048-bit fingerprint -> 256 (GELU, dropout 0.2); line embedding 16; optional pathway_level_2 embedding 16
transition.form: delta_z = sum_{k=1,2} g_k(dose) * v_k(compound, line); g_k = dose/(dose + EC50_k); log10 EC50_k = 1 + 4*sigmoid(.) (10 nM to 100 uM); g_k(0) = 0 exactly
transition.loss: mse(z_control + delta_z, z_treated) + mse(decoder(delta_z), standardised shift)

latent.standardisation: gene-wise centering on training vehicle minibulks; scale sqrt(var_g + median(var))

responsive: shift norm above the 95th percentile of a vehicle null built from control cells split into pseudo-groups, rescaled by sqrt(n0 / n) to the group's cell count

metrics.B1_specificity: Pearson(prediction - systematic, observed - systematic) over genes, per condition; mean within compound, then over compounds; 95% CI by 2000 compound bootstrap resamples
metrics.B2_scramble: B1 and uncentered MSE skill recomputed after permuting the gene order of the centered prediction; a metric that survives is magnitude-driven
metrics.B3_moa_retrieval: concatenated three-line centered 10 uM prediction vs observed training-fold profiles; top-1 pathway_level_2 match; compared with the observed-profile ceiling, chemistry nearest-neighbour label transfer and a label-permutation null; arms that take the annotation as input are excluded
metrics.B4_potency: Spearman over compounds between predicted and observed shift norm at 10 uM, per line
metrics.B5_context: Pearson over genes and lines of (prediction - three-line mean) vs (observed - three-line mean) at 10 uM, per compound; and most-responsive-line accuracy
metrics.B6_anchors: research/biological_depth/anchors.json, scored identically on observed shifts and on out-of-fold predictions
metrics.B7_uncertainty: Spearman between per-condition ensemble spread and per-condition error; B1 among the most-confident half versus all
metrics.B8_cross_assay: exploratory: Spearman between observed or predicted 10 uM shift norm and PRISM secondary AUC for A549 and MCF7

primary_comparisons: P1: latent_jepa minus knn_chem on B1 over responsive conditions (paired by compound)
P2: latent_jepa minus latent_pca on B1 over responsive conditions (does learned representation help?)
P3: anchors reproduced by latent_jepa versus mlp_existing, among anchors that hold in the observed data

verdict_rules.data_carries_biology: at least 7 of the 10 anchors hold in the observed data
verdict_rules.specific_signal: B1 over responsive conditions has a 95% CI lower bound above 0
verdict_rules.beyond_retrieval: paired B1 difference versus knn_chem has a 95% CI lower bound above 0
verdict_rules.near_ceiling: B1 at least half of the replicate ceiling on the same conditions
verdict_rules.anchor_depth: reproduces at least half of the anchors that hold in the observed data, out of fold
verdict_rules.knows_what_it_does_not_know: B7 Spearman above 0 with a 95% CI lower bound above 0
verdict_rules.note: A verdict applies to 24 h SciPlex3 transcriptional responses in three lines. It licenses no claim about viability, engagement, other contexts or mechanism.

agent_probe.population: compounds responsive at 10 uM in at least one line whose pathway_level_2 class holds at least 2 skeleton groups; up to 40 compounds in sha256('maestro-biodepth-agent|' + skeleton) order
agent_probe.input: per responsive line, the 20 most increased and 20 most decreased genes of the centered observed shift, and the shift-norm percentile; no compound name, structure or annotation
agent_probe.options: the pathway_level_2 classes present in the population
arms: tool: nearest-class retrieval over other compounds' observed profiles
agent_probe.tool_card: top 3 classes by cosine similarity of the query's observed profile to other skeleton groups' observed profiles, labelled as a retrieved analysis of measured data
agent_probe.metrics: top-1 accuracy with compound-bootstrap 95% CI; primary: deepseek_signature_plus_tool_card minus deepseek_signature (paired); Jev agreement over 3 repeats on 10 compounds
